in_arabic.name: Anasat
in_arabic.long_meaning: Anasat هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the name Anas ibn Malik, meaning the supporter or helper. A name for a boy who is kind, loyal, and always there to support and help those around him.
